_note: Translation of the Japanese draft. Traditional accounts remain attributed.

chapter.title: Retreat from Kanegasaki
chapter.intro: As Oda troops march into Echizen, word comes that Azai Nagamasa has turned against them. Caught between two armies, Nobunaga orders a retreat. Legend says Oichi warned him with a bag of beans tied at both ends, while Hideyoshi and his comrades held the rear. Break through the encirclement and open the road to Kyoto.

長蛇.name: Long Serpent Formation
長蛇.intro: Troops march in a long single file. It suits narrow roads and valleys but leaves the flank exposed.

方円.name: Circle Formation
方円.intro: Troops form a defensive ring around their commander, ready for attacks from any direction.

鶴翼.name: Crane's Wing Formation
鶴翼.intro: Troops form a V like a crane's outstretched wings, enveloping attackers from both sides.

魚鱗.name: Fish Scale Formation
魚鱗.intro: Troops form layered triangles like fish scales, concentrating force to break the enemy line head-on.

雁行.name: Wild Geese Formation
雁行.intro: Troops march diagonally like geese in flight, ready to answer threats on the flank.

偃月.name: Crescent Moon Formation
偃月.intro: Troops form a crescent and charge behind their commander. It lifts morale while exposing the commander to danger.

総懸かり.name: Full Assault Formation
総懸かり.intro: The whole army charges together, breaking formation for one decisive assault.

鋒矢.name: Arrowhead Formation
鋒矢.intro: An arrowhead concentrates force in the vanguard to pierce a single point in the enemy line.

衡軛.name: Yoke Formation
衡軛.intro: Two staggered columns advance while supporting one another.

03_秀吉.name: Kinoshita Tokichiro
03_秀吉.line: He is said to have volunteered to hold the rear so his comrades could withdraw.

01_信长.name: Oda Nobunaga
01_信长.line: Learning of the danger, he withdrew to Kyoto through Kutsuki Valley.

10_元康.name: Tokugawa Ieyasu
10_元康.line: He is said to have helped the Oda in the fighting retreat.

08_阿市.name: Oichi
08_阿市.line: Nagamasa's wife. Legend says she warned her brother with a bag of red beans.

10_龍興.name: Saito Tatsuoki
10_龍興.line: He is said to have turned to the Asakura after losing Mino.

06_光秀.name: Akechi Mitsuhide
06_光秀.line: He is said to have helped hold the rear alongside Hideyoshi.

07_久秀.name: Matsunaga Hisahide
07_久秀.line: He is said to have persuaded Mototsuna to let Nobunaga's party through.

08_元綱.name: Kutsuki Mototsuna
08_元綱.line: Lord of Kutsuki Valley, said to have allowed Nobunaga's party to pass.

09_熙子.name: Hiroko
09_熙子.line: Mitsuhide's wife, said to have sold her hair to fund his banquet.

10_長政.name: Azai Nagamasa
10_長政.line: He held to his ties with the Asakura and turned against Nobunaga.

11_久政.name: Azai Hisamasa
11_久政.line: Nagamasa's father, said to have valued the alliance with the Asakura.

12_直経.name: Endo Naotsune
12_直経.line: An Azai commander said to have urged caution toward Nobunaga.

13_義景.name: Asakura Yoshikage
13_義景.line: Lord of Echizen, known for his love of culture.

14_直隆.name: Magara Naotaka
14_直隆.line: An Asakura champion said to have wielded a great blade.

rules.falling: When you match tiles, the tiles above them drop.
rules.construction: The top row shows the next timber supply. Each column with room gets one tile. Timber waits above full columns. Clear the board and all timber to win. Retreat restores both, and the clock keeps running.
rules.siege: Barricades spread inward through empty spaces from the edge. Tiles stay in place. Breakout removes the innermost layer. If you have no matches and no Breakout uses left, you lose.
rules.boss: Rearguard: Clear all four Nagamasa tiles before the third barricade closes in.
